summary: Hotpath tuner escape hatch and validation checks for tenant-induced latency surge
description:
Issue summary: LuminaHealth reported a sharp increase in 95th/99th percentile token latency after enabling a tenant-scoped optimizer profile change (aggressive batching + prefix KV prefetch + 4-bit quant profile). Impact began around 2026-03-09 22:40 UTC for us-west production.

We suspect an interaction between the mixed-precision quant profile and continuous-batching heuristics that causes increased KV eviction churn and tail latency spikes for long-context requests. Customer is on a Dedicated pool with reserved GPUs and needs guidance for a fast, safe rollback without traffic disruption or model-version pin conflict.
impact: Customer-facing latency spikes (95p from ~180ms to 1.2s, 99p up to 2.5s) affecting batch inference endpoints for LuminaHealth main API. Some requests hit soft timeouts; customer reported user-facing slowdowns. No billing discrepancy reported. Potential risk of SLA breach if not remediated within 24h.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) LuminaHealth applied tenant optimizer profile 'opt-hotpath-v3' on 2026-03-09 via Console -> Tenant Config
2) Run mixed-length chat requests (context ~6k tokens) against model redwood-open-2.7 in us-west dedicated pool
3) Observe backend token-level latency distribution and increased KV eviction count in serving-runtime metrics
4) Compare before/after traces in Console per-route tracing view
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: mixed 4-bit quantization combined with aggressive async batching increased memory pressure and forced frequent KV cache evictions for long context sessions.
Telemetry: grafana/dashboard/ref: /d/latency/tenant-latency?var-tenant=luminahealth shows correlated spike at 2026-03-09 22:40 UTC; eviction_delta metric jumps from baseline ~20/s to >1000/s.
Reproduced in staging by applying profile to small tenant in us-west staging pool; confirmed similar tail behavior under synthetic long-context traffic.
Config snapshot: snapshot_id=snap-20260309-2240 saved before any immediate mitigation (console link included in Confluence runbook).
Related artifacts: slack thread #support (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C0123456) and #infra thread (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C0654321).
Quick check: GPU memory usage shows higher page fault/allocator churn after profile applied; kernel selection logs show fallback to slower kernels for large sequences when quant mode engaged.
comments: 2026-03-10 08:15 - Marco Hernandez (Support): Thanks Anika — we are triaging. Can you grant SRE temporary access to LuminaHealth tenant metrics via the console (we requested read-only link)?
2026-03-10 09:02 - LuminaHealth (Alice Chen, CS): Access granted for 24h. We see user complaints for slow document summarization endpoints.

2026-03-10 10:30 - Marco Hernandez (Support): Performed staging repro and confirmed eviction spike. Drafting safe escape-hatch steps: 1) toggle prefix-kv prefetch off for tenant, 2) reduce async batch target to 32, 3) revert quant profile to 8-bit. Holding for customer approval.
2026-03-10 11:05 - Alice Chen (LuminaHealth): Please proceed with non-disruptive changes first (toggle prefetch), prefer console-guided change we can monitor.
2026-03-11 02:20 - SRE (Jordan Liu): Ran preflight checks, snapshot snap-20260310-1120 created. Will apply prefetch=false now in canary (10% traffic) and monitor for 30 minutes.

2026-03-11 03:00 - SRE (Jordan Liu): Canary looks good: 95p latency dropped to ~220ms and evictions reduced to ~30/s. Preparing staged rollback plan to revert 'opt-hotpath-v3' to 'opt-safe-v2' per runbook.

2026-03-12 14:45 - Marco Hernandez (Support): Moving ticket to In Progress for full rollback scheduling with LuminaHealth. Next steps: coordinate maintenance window and follow rollback checklist in Confluence.
suggested_workaround: Apply a staged, non-disruptive escape hatch: 1) In Console -> Tenant Config create a canary override for LuminaHealth that sets prefix_kv_prefetch=false and target_async_batch=32 for 10% of traffic; 2) Monitor evictions and 95p latency for 30 minutes; 3) If improvement, roll traffic to 100% then restore quant profile to 8-bit; 4) If regress, restore snapshot snap-20260309-2240 and open escalation to Runtime team.
resolution: In Progress — canary toggle applied and observed improvement; awaiting customer approval for full staged rollback to opt-safe-v2 and quant profile change. Final resolution to include post-mortem and recommended optimizer-safe defaults for dedicated customers.
follow_up_tasks: Schedule 1-hour maintenance window with LuminaHealth for full rollback and QA
Create automated eviction alert to trigger escape-hatch throttles for dedicated tenants
Update optimizer docs with explicit guidance for long-context workloads and safe-rollback checklist
Add unit/integration test for mixed-precision + async-batching interaction in CI
